neighbours.label: words saying someone or something has grown, matured, changed or improved over a stretch of time (grown a lot, matured, a big change in her, how much he has improved), as against the same subjects described as they are now or doing something unrelated
fire: My nephew has grown so much since I last saw him at Christmas.
Over the past two seasons the young striker has matured enormously.
Her confidence has improved a lot since she joined the drama club.
Friends say he is a completely changed person after the trip to India.
After a month of therapy, his parents noticed a huge difference in his mood.
The puppy has doubled in size in just a few weeks.
You can really see how much her writing has developed this year.
Since the surgery, my father has gained weight and looks much healthier.
quiet: My nephew is tall and loves playing football at Christmas.
The young striker scored twice in the cup final on Sunday.
She joined the drama club because her best friend was in it.
Friends say he took the trip to India with his cousin.
After a month of therapy, his parents moved to a new flat.
The puppy sleeps in a basket next to the kitchen door.
Her writing class meets every Thursday in the library.
My father had the surgery at the hospital near our house.
